text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, Calstone 
Light O suddenly stopped in her tracks and 
spoke.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I want to go to that wharf again. Would 
you mind accompanying me?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I came up with a strategy to 
befriend that kitty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon reaching the wharf, Calstone Light O 
went straight to a nearby fishing rod 
rental shop, and came straight back.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Heh, are you surprised? This is—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It's the 'I'm an angler, so I'm not 
interested in kitties' strategy."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"They say a cat will run if it feels 
targeted. However, if someone isn't paying 
attention to it, its curiosity is piqued 
and it approaches on its own."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's quickly pretend to be fishers. 
I borrowed some gear for you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wash... crash...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The gentle sound of waves and the cries of 
sea birds... Holding my fishing rod 
alongside Calstone Light O, we quietly 
gaze out at the sea.
choice_data_list:
(She's always so busy, so this feels kind 
of fresh...)

(She's always so restless, so this is kind 
of refreshing...)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Just now, a kitty... Ah, no... don't 
look, don't look...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's painful. To ignore a kitty like this. 
But it's started wandering around behind 
us, hasn't it? Should we just keep 
ignoring it...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhhhh, I can't! No way! I feel like I'm 
gonna look back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O looks ready to throw down 
her fishing rod and dash over to the cat 
at any second. I need to find a way to 
distract her.
choice_data_list: Light O, don't the clouds look fast today?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, the clouds? Now that you mention it. 
Is it because the wind is strong?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They look slow from down here, but clouds 
actually move at 40 to 50 km/h... or so I 
thought I'd mention.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That's quite some speed.
choice_data_list: I wonder who's faster, you or Light O?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Me, of course! If only I could run 
across the sky...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"At times like this, I run a race in my 
head. Even as the clouds rush past, my 
legs are like lightning... Ha!"

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text:
Nnnn..."å¤}, {"id": 14, "en": "Neeeee... 
rvousssss...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Right...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A cat was sniffing at Calstone Light O's 
ankle with curious snorts. She breathed 
heavily from her shoulders without 
twitching an inch."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Please be quiet, or the kitty will run 
away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Calstone Light O splendidly 
succeeded in petting them!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy. Happy, happy, happy. I feel 
like dancing and shouting 'Woohoo----!'

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the operation almost failed, but 
talking with Trainer helped distract me...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ah! So that means it's thanks to Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I want to thank you. Please let me show my 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Expressing gratitude and apologies is best 
done quickly. Oh, that reminds me—next 
time, I'll accompany you to wherever you 
want to go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Is there anywhere you'd like to go? Let's 
go together, right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't have anywhere specific in mind. 
So... I gave an answer thinking of a place 
she would enjoy.
choice_data_list: Let's shout our joy out at karaoke!
Let's go eat some celebratory cake.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great. I love shops like that. 
Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for the meal. Allow me to 
thank you once again.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Is that enough? Would you like to add 
dessert? It's my treat today only.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... I can't think of any words 
other than "thank you." How can I show my 
gratitude through my actions?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Well then... "thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Bow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O thanked me repeatedly all 
the way home.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"What a coincidence. I've been suppressing 
my love for cats all this time, so I felt 
like shouting, 'Whoaa!'"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Cat, cat, cat! Cat, cat, caaaat! Cat, cat, 
cat! Cat, cat, caaaat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O looks so happy. Just 
watching her puts a smile on my face, 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
YO! Seriously, big thanks! Thanks to you, 
we're total cat besties! Embracing the 
miracle of meeting you, Trainer! 
YEAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's a parody of a rap song I like. This 
song is really fast-paced and has a 
straightforward pitch, which is great.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Calstone Light O expressed her 
gratitude to a pumped-up, high-tempo beat!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see, today truly is a day to celebrate. 
It's Cat Memorial Day. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
This shop has such a calm atmosphere. It 
feels refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let me thank you once again. 
Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"You always match my pace and keep up with 
me. Thank you so very much."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There aren't many people who could pull 
this off. You're the best. I'm truly 
grateful. I want you to stay by my side 
and support me forever.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the cake is here. Now, time to 
celebrate. Happy Nyanko Anniversary. Happy 
anniversary to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if nothing had happened, she happily 
devoured the cake, saying how delicious it 
was. ...From here on out, I'll continue to 
support her with everything I've got!
